command:
; macOS Seatbelt example. /private/tmp/ai-native-s07-i_ufix76 is replaced with the disposable workspace.
; This demonstrates selected file and network boundaries, not full host isolation.
(version 1)
(allow default)
(deny file-write*)
(allow file-write*
  (subpath "/private/tmp/ai-native-s07-i_ufix76/src")
  (subpath "/private/tmp/ai-native-s07-i_ufix76/tests")
  (subpath "/private/tmp/ai-native-s07-i_ufix76/build")
  (literal "/dev/null"))
(deny file-read* (subpath "/private/tmp/ai-native-s07-i_ufix76/secrets"))
(deny network*)
